title: Waitlist and contact submissions reach the API from the marketing host

comments.author: home
comments.text:
As a prospective customer, I want the waitlist survey and contact form to work
on the new marketing site, so that lead capture is not broken by the split.

**Blocked by:** S1. **Runs in parallel with:** S2.

---
Feature: Same-origin API access from the marketing host

  Scenario: A waitlist survey submission succeeds
    Given the marketing distribution has its own /api* behavior to the thin-turn
      Lambda function URL
    When a visitor submits the waitlist survey on the marketing site
    Then the submission is accepted with no CORS error
    And the signup is scored and stored exactly as it is today

  Scenario: A contact form submission succeeds
    When a visitor submits the services contact form on the marketing site
    Then the submission is accepted with no CORS error

**Done when:** both scenarios pass against the marketing distribution before
DNS cutover, with lib/config.ts's apiBase contract unchanged.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Verified live against production: GET https://www.chattic.us/api/waitlist/survey returned 200 with the real survey schema; POST https://www.chattic.us/api/waitlist and POST https://www.chattic.us/api/contact both returned 201 {status: recorded} against the real thin-turn backend, proving the marketing distribution's /api* same-origin proxy reaches this repo's production API.
